name: Sugar Plum Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: This sweet and earthy-flavored sativa is truly a treat. With a light body high built for creativity, this strain leaves no limitations on the imagination. With hints of sour notes to round out the trifecta of flavors, this multi-sensory experience is perfect for any night. Life can always be sweeter with our new infused sugar plum pre-rolls.
